<translate>
'''King Yemma''' sits in the cloud realm of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld|Otherworld]], where spirits arrive after death. He teaches no skills: his service sends you back to the living world when you're alive or on a temporary return from [[Special:MyLanguage/Fortuneteller Baba|Fortuneteller Baba]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Location ==
</translate>
<translate>
King Yemma's check-in area is in the Otherworld's main cloud deck, next to the spirit arrival point. [[Special:MyLanguage/Fortuneteller Baba|Fortuneteller Baba]], the [[Special:MyLanguage/Grand Kai|Grand Kai]] and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Hell Ogre|Hell Ogre]] stand nearby.
</translate>

<translate>
== Return to Earth ==
</translate>
<translate>
* '''Return to Earth''' teleports you back to the living world (your spawn point) and closes the dialogue.
* It works when you're alive, or when you're dead but have borrowed time from Fortuneteller Baba (a temporary return).
* While you're dead without borrowed time, the option is locked: talk to Baba first. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld#Death and revival|Death and revival]].
</translate>
